entries.title: MediSyn
entries.summary: 文字引导的潜空间扩散模型，覆盖多个医学专科与影像类型。
entries.summary_en: A text-guided latent diffusion model spanning multiple medical specialties and image types.
entries.note: 已正式收录，原论文图、机制讲解与专著新章节已同步。
entries.note_en: Published with the original paper figure, mechanism guide and synchronized compendium chapter.

entries.title: Percival
entries.summary: 通过三维 CT 与报告的对比学习，建立图像与语言表征。
entries.summary_en: Contrastive learning aligns full 3D CT volumes with radiology reports.
entries.note: 已正式收录，原论文图、十步机制讲解与专著第 140 章已同步。
entries.note_en: Published with the original journal figure, ten-stage mechanism guide and synchronized compendium chapter 140.

entries.title: ContiLNN
entries.summary: 在二维复原主干中加入双向液态动力学，利用相邻切片与间隔信息。
entries.summary_en: Bidirectional liquid dynamics add neighboring-slice context and slice intervals to a 2D restoration backbone.
entries.note: 双向 CfC 与原图已核对；图中医学影像素材的再使用范围仍待确认。
entries.note_en: Bidirectional CfC mechanism and original figure checked; reuse terms for the medical images within the figure remain to be confirmed.

entries.title: AMIFound
entries.summary: 通过编码器—解码器与频率感知专家路由，统一处理七类医学影像复原任务。
entries.summary_en: An encoder–decoder with frequency-aware expert routing unifies restoration tasks across seven medical imaging modalities.
entries.note: 原图展示许可继续核对；作者代码现明确仅供学术评审与复现，复制和分发需书面许可。
entries.note_en: Figure display permission remains under review. Author code now explicitly limits use to academic review and reproducibility; copying and distribution require written permission.

entries.title: MedGemma
entries.summary: 将医学图文训练的视觉编码器与 Gemma 3 结合，支持医学图像与文本问答。
entries.summary_en: A medically trained vision encoder and Gemma 3 support medical image and text question answering.
entries.note: 已正式收录，原论文图、十步机制讲解与专著第 141 章已同步。
entries.note_en: Published with the original journal figure, ten-stage mechanism guide and synchronized compendium chapter 141.

entries.title: Brain2Vec
entries.summary: 用三维遮蔽自编码学习 T1 脑 MRI 表征。预训练重建被遮蔽体块，应用时提取 768 维全脑嵌入，或以编码器初始化下游模型。
entries.summary_en: A 3D masked autoencoder learns T1 brain MRI representations. Masked-volume reconstruction trains an encoder that supplies 768-dimensional embeddings or initializes downstream models.
entries.note: 自查完成，原论文图、机制讲解与专著新章节正在同步正式版。
entries.note_en: Review complete. The original paper figure, mechanism guide and compendium chapter are being synchronized to the formal edition.
